inputs.checklistItemText: Equipment pad installed within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle routes lacks required 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts (bollards) per AE Design equipment pad details, or bollards not spaced to allow equipment door opening
inputs.question: Are any transformer pads located within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle circulation routes? If so, are bollards shown on the plan for these transformer pads? Are bollard specifications or detail references shown on this sheet?

output.reasoning: The agent is performing progressive verification: first identifying presence of transformer pads near parking/routes (presence check), then checking for bollard presence and specification references (feature/label readout). These are all visual identification and documentation checks, not distance measurements. The actual clearance measurement (4 feet) is already given as a constraint; the agent is verifying compliance artifacts (bollards, details) rather than measuring distances.
